# Hermes runtime source for Nemo

This reviewed source-only snapshot derives from Hermes Agent (Nous Research),
maintained in a downstream fork at revision `02628e07d7ce56283e5fed612f8bef3cbcbb3dfe`.
The original MIT licence is in LICENSE; nested third-party LICENSE/NOTICE files
remain beside their code. See ../../desktop/hermes-source.json for exact bytes
and upstream provenance. Private Git history and account/configuration data are
excluded. Optional skill packs, including separately licensed datasets, are not
part of Nemo's restricted read-only runtime.

Core source files are unmodified. Nemo supplies identity, permissions, transport
and its restricted tool policy outside this tree. Generic Windows-path examples
in code comments are reviewed examples, not a maintainer's installation paths.
The installed runtime is built from this public snapshot and pinned public
Python/wheel inputs; no private repository credentials are needed.
